fixture.name: period
fixture.setup: RecordedAt at from minus 1ns, from, to minus 1ns and to; Order.PlacedAt intentionally differs

rows.assertion: Only [from,to) event RecordedAt contributes; actual allocation quantities survive later recipe changes.

fixture.name: eligible-stock
fixture.setup: Eligible, zero, pending and just-expired batches for the same product

rows.assertion: Only positive, nonpending stock with expiry strictly after capture contributes, before any scheduler transition.

fixture.name: consumption
fixture.setup: One order, one pending transition, one human confirmed writeoff and one legacy automatic expiry

rows.assertion: Count order allocation plus human writeoff once; pending/legacy expiry contributes zero.

fixture.name: no-history
fixture.setup: Empty journal with sufficient stock, then a one-portion deficit

rows.assertion: No invented usage/finite coverage; no row when enough stock; deficit-only suggestion otherwise.

fixture.name: partial-history
fixture.setup: Coverage starts inside the 7-day window, then exactly at window start

rows.assertion: Average denominator remains 7; complete false/true and availableFrom=max(from,coverageFrom).

fixture.name: threshold
fixture.setup: Consumed quantity 7000 and available 2999,3000,3001 in separate captures

rows.assertion: Only 2999 triggers low_coverage; exact comparison precedes six-place display rounding.

fixture.name: deficit
fixture.setup: Two dishes require 5000 and 7000 of one product with available 2000

rows.assertion: Deficit 5000, not 8000; sorted blockedDishIDs contains both dishes; suggestion max(target,deficit).

fixture.name: quantity
fixture.setup: Products in g/ml/pcs, fractional base-unit quantum and exact target ceiling

rows.assertion: No cross-unit sum; average in base units/day; ceil to existing 0.001 quantum; deterministic ID order.

fixture.name: overflow
fixture.setup: Individually valid events whose period sum exceeds int64, and a capacity overflow

rows.assertion: Typed CalculationUnavailable/LimitExceeded, never wraparound or truncated successful data.

fixture.name: read-only
fixture.setup: Capture before/after event version and batches while expiry is due

rows.assertion: No new event, writeoff, reservation or delivery; repeat results coherent and returned values cannot mutate owner.

fixture.name: scope
fixture.setup: Wrong org/tenant/epoch/settings, expired credentials and Waiter-only token

rows.assertion: Current scoped refusal mapping; no cross-restaurant data or read elevation.

fixture.name: public-ui
fixture.setup: Real scoped read through Gateway in existing Warehouse tab

rows.assertion: Strict FIN1 response; pending/empty/error/partial history visible; stale/cancelled scope cannot install result.

fixture.name: risk-window
fixture.setup: Expiry at capture, capture+72h, capture+72h+1ns and pending positive stock

rows.assertion: Include only capture<expiry<=capture+72h, positive and nonpending.

fixture.name: availability
fixture.setup: Unavailable dish, available no-risk dish and available risky dish

rows.assertion: Return only available dishes with risky product; no stock reservation.

fixture.name: fish-parsley-rice
fixture.setup: completion-v1-examples.json recommendation-inputs and recommendations

rows.assertion: Fish score 0.666667 > parsley 0.133333; rice six months away excluded; reason r includes fresh parsley allocations.

fixture.name: whole-recipe
fixture.setup: Risky 1g plus fresh 4g cover one 5g parsley portion

rows.assertion: r=5g and A=1/5; do not use 1g as the whole recipe quantity.

fixture.name: aggregation
fixture.setup: Two risky batches of one product with different expiry and a second risky product

rows.assertion: W=sum eligible horizon batches; earliest batch/expiry supplies t; one reason per product; dish score sums factors.

fixture.name: edge-quantities
fixture.setup: W<r, W=r, W>r and W=0

rows.assertion: A=min(1,W/r); zero risk has no reason/division; target portions ceil(W/r).

fixture.name: demand-history
fixture.setup: Complete coverage with one dish having 168 recorded portions and a second no orders

rows.assertion: Demand first 1 portion/hour with history basis; second 2/hour fallback. RecordedAt boundaries apply.

fixture.name: demand-fallback
fixture.setup: Partial coverage even with recorded orders

rows.assertion: Exactly 2 portions/hour fallback; explicit partial coverage; no extrapolated full-history claim.

fixture.name: exact-ranking
fixture.setup: Two exact scores differ below six decimals; equal exact scores/expiry; more than ten dishes

rows.assertion: Sort exact score descending then expiry then dishID; wire rounding does not determine ties; at most ten.

fixture.name: finite-score
fixture.setup: Subsecond positive expiry, large int64 quantities/portion counts, several products

rows.assertion: Exact rational intermediates; finite nonnegative six-decimal score and checked target quantities.

fixture.name: coherent-input
fixture.setup: Mutate scope/state during transport; mismatched menu/window/prefix/epoch/settings

rows.assertion: Reject inconsistent capture; menu/risk/demand share capture; no raw orders leave Warehouse.

fixture.name: least-privilege
fixture.setup: Recommendations user policy and stock/history-only policies

rows.assertion: Only recommendation policy grants consumer.recommendations.read; endpoint checks it; no broad stock/history escalation.

fixture.name: strict-boundary
fixture.setup: Malformed/exponential/overflow quantities, unknown fields and upstream typed failures

rows.assertion: Gateway/client strict rejection; unavailable is never converted to successful empty recommendations.

fixture.name: existing-ui
fixture.setup: Existing recommendations tab against real assembled services, then scope/logout/unmount

rows.assertion: Reasons and demand/coverage shown without new page; minute refresh and SSE invalidation are cancelled on scope end.
